pages.text: The $(item)Gene Splicer$() puts up to three genes from your library into a $(item)Serum Cassette$(). Watch the stability before you splice: conflicting genes cost stability, synergies add some, and a catalyst helps. Below 60 a serum may mutate whatever it goes into.

Serums go into your own body at the $(item)Injection Rig$(), into a host by hand, or into a Chimera's Gene Ports. Mismatched blood can be rejected; mecha never reject. $(item)Gene Wash$() starts you over.
